scope: MIT covers original project contributions only. The game additions and shared edits describe the October 2026 Platinum snapshot. The component decisions govern redistribution of compiled artifacts.
migration_policy: Use the historical project_files and game_additions allowlists from licensing/redistribution.json at bceb3bbff814079eeed5c73c1e8c2d7549b18588. Exclude every other path when exporting historical trees.
Relocate original game additions outside the ignored upstream workspace. Recreate shared-file edits with reviewed project changes; do not export complete modified upstream files or binary assets.
Preserve authors, dates and messages with an original-to-migrated commit map. Keep the complete original repository and PR history private.
Review newly added paths and copied content before extending the allowlist; a directory name or file extension does not prove ownership.
Check all reachable public history, tags, source archives, artifact layers and secret exposure before publication.

Anything distributed that is based on it, such as a future integration patch, a modified source file or a BPS patch or ROM built from it, must be offered under GPL-3.0 with the license text, its notices and the complete corresponding source: the exact pokebw2 revision, the integration patch, the project additions it links and the build scripts. Project code combined into such a build must be GPL-3.0-compatible (MIT and Apache-2.0 are). The GPL does not cover the game's own code, graphics, text and data, which the build extracts from the player's dump: never commit or publish the dump, orig/, extract/ or build/ output.

components.name: DS Companion: BlocksDS startup and ARM7 core
components.license: MPL-2.0 (crt0); MPL-2.0 AND FSFAP (linker scripts); Zlib (DSL loader, ARM7 core and version library)
components.requirements: Use the LUNE-862 builder image skylyrac/blocksds:slim-v1.25.0@sha256:c5f19b95d9c2f312e6a68ea244d2ed5120203b4b82af9785937a349096f8e5e4 (multi-architecture index), whose SDK version is v1.25.0, at the listed source commit and nested gitlinks below. It is not a single-licence SDK. The default ARM9 and ARM7 crt0 assembly is MPL-2.0: ship licensing/ds-companion-blocksds.txt and inform recipients that its Source Code Form is under MPL-2.0 and where to obtain that form and licence. Make the exact covered source (including any changes) available by reasonable, timely means at no more than distribution cost; supply sys/crts/ plus modifications with the .nds zip, or maintain an accessible matching source download and state its location in the zip. A bare promise of source is insufficient. Preserve notices and FSFAP linker-script notices in source copies. MPL file-level copyleft permits the larger statically linked application under its own compatible terms and does not require disclosure of unrelated files. Zlib requires accurate origin, marked source changes and preserved source notices; no mandatory binary attribution or source offer, but include these notices in the zip. LUNE-862 explicitly selects sys/arm7/main_core/arm7_minimal.elf: its Makefile.generic defaults USE_DSWIFI, USE_MAXMOD and USE_LIBXM7 to 0, linking libnds7 and libc without Wi-Fi or audio libraries. Its main.c has additional Copyright (C) 2023 Antonio Niño Díaz attribution, retained in the bundled notice. The current client/companion/src/platform/nds/arm7/main.c adapts the DSWiFi core to control Slot-1 power. Include the separate DSWiFi/lwIP/Mbed TLS notices below. This review covers dependencies, not an actual .nds or its publication approval.

Keep the full upstream CC0 text in LICENSES/CC0-1.0.txt and ship it in the .nds zip as project policy. Original DSWT changes remain under the project MIT licence. This review covers the Makefile template, not example assets or the BlocksDS logo.

Include LICENSES/CC0-1.0.txt with the .nds zip as project policy. This covers only the default ROM icon, not the separately licensed BlocksDS logo or other example assets.

components.license: MIT; bundled lwIP and Mbed TLS have separate terms
components.requirements: Use the DSWiFi gitlink from BlocksDS v1.25.0, including its DSi/TWL driver derived from dsiwifi; do not substitute a separately downloaded dsiwifi tree. Its driver files carry MIT identifiers, including Daz Jones (2015-2016), Max Thomas (2021) and Antonio Niño Díaz (2025); COPYING also credits Stephen Stair and Dave Murphy. include/dsiwifi7_bmi.h carries MIT and Copyright (C) 2026 PoroCYon. The bundled version macros identify 3.6.4; pin the DSWiFi subtree, including its TWL changes, rather than substituting stock Mbed TLS. Exercise the Apache-2.0 option, not the GPL option. Include licensing/ds-companion-mbedtls.txt and Copyright The Mbed TLS Contributors in the .nds zip; the copied upstream file preserves both offered licence texts, but distribution selects Apache-2.0. components.name: DS Companion: bounded Mbed TLS 4.1.1 with TF-PSA-Crypto 1.2.0
components.license: Apache-2.0 (selected from dual Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later)
components.requirements: The client/companion/Makefile from LUNE-862 builds libwt_tls.a from game/mbedtls-4.1.1, including its TF-PSA-Crypto 1.2.0, and links it into the ARM9 .nds. This is the companion's own TLS dependency using the shared bounded client profile, separate from DSWiFi's ARM7 Mbed TLS 3.6.4 subset and the game client distribution scope. Use the SHA-256-pinned archive in client/core/tls-dependency.json. Ship licensing/mbedtls.txt (Apache-2.0) and Copyright The Mbed TLS Contributors with every .nds zip. Preserve applicable upstream notices and identify modified source files if redistributed; static linking requires no application copyleft or source offer under Apache-2.0. The bounded tls_config.h and crypto_config.h leave MBEDTLS_ECDH_VARIANT_EVEREST_ENABLED and MBEDTLS_PSA_P256M_DRIVER_ENABLED undefined. Although the upstream build compiles everest and p256-m translation units, their implementation bodies are preprocessed out: neither contributes driver code under this profile. Everest's separate Copyright 2016-2018 INRIA and Microsoft Corporation (Apache-2.0), and p256-m's Mbed TLS Contributors copyright and Manuel Pégourié-Gonnard author credit, therefore add no driver notice requirement for this executable. Re-audit these and any other enabled drivers if configuration changes. Inspect final ARM9 linked objects and release contents before distribution; no final .nds is cleared here.

components.name: DS Companion: GCC runtime libraries
components.license: GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1 (libgcc; libstdc++ if C++ is linked)
components.requirements: The pinned v1.25.0 image installs Wonderful GCC package 1:16.2.0.r229124.be93d9d35bf-1 (including gcc-libs and matching libstdc++), whose revision resolves to the full Codeberg source commit above. Under those conditions a statically linked .nds does not need application or runtime source disclosure/offer solely because of these libraries. Ship LICENSES/GPL-3.0-or-later.txt and LICENSES/GCC-exception-3.1.txt and preserve applicable FSF/runtime attribution. Distributing standalone runtime libraries, modified library source, GCC executables or a toolchain image is a separate GPL corresponding-source obligation; the exception is not a blanket waiver. The image package database and compiler were verified on linux/arm64; inspect final linked objects before release and verify packages on any other build architecture.
